patient.history_present_illness: Mrs. Thompson is a 68-year-old woman with right frontal glioblastoma on bevacizumab and dexamethasone who is brought by ambulance after her husband called 911 when she developed a focal motor seizure involving the right arm that progressively spread and secondarily generalized to bilateral tonic-clonic activity. The seizure has been continuous for approximately 18 minutes. She had her most recent bevacizumab infusion 5 days ago. Her husband notes she has been increasingly fatigued and had worsening headaches over the past 10 days, which she attributed to the GBM. She missed her morning levetiracetam dose today due to nausea from the bevacizumab. Her dexamethasone was recently tapered from 8 mg/day to 4 mg/day over the past 2 weeks on oncology's instruction. She has progressive disease that has been growing despite bevacizumab. She also takes citalopram. She is right-handed.
